about: FROZEN second unseen Deep set (2026-10-27). Written blind to how the system behaves: the pipeline was not run on these items and no model output for them was read. 14 answerable items (each needs two or more separate passages) and 6 should-decline lookalikes (not-in-sources or false premise), over the books corpus. Prefers Time Machine, Madame Bovary, Don Quijote, Die Verwandlung, Noli Me Tangere, Alice and Sherlock stories the earlier Deep sets did not ask about. Every required string is an English-writable name (ASCII, no transliteration, no foreign word) because the questions are English and the answers will be English. Labels were written from my own knowledge of the books, then the corpus was queried only to confirm each fact is present or absent (evals/deep/unseen2_audit.json, with the gold chunk ids). Scoring fields as test_items.json: mention_all = strings the answer must all contain. Do not edit after the freeze: the SHA-256 of this file and of unseen2_audit.json is pinned by a test.
